definitions.gloss: to shake, to rock, to sway
definitions.explanation: To cause something to move back and forth or side to side. The transitive form of {揺|ゆ}れる.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんをゆりかごで{揺|ゆ}らす。
examples.english: I rock the baby in the cradle.

examples.japanese: {風|かぜ}が{木|き}の{枝|えだ}を{揺|ゆ}らしている。
examples.english: The wind is shaking the tree branches.

examples.japanese: {肩|かた}を{揺|ゆ}らして{笑|わら}う。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pair: {揺|ゆ}れる (intransitive, to sway). Pattern: Xを{揺|ゆ}らす (shake X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing action. {揺|ゆ}らしている = 'is shaking.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{体|からだ}を{揺|ゆ}らす (sway one's body)
・ゆりかごを{揺|ゆ}らす (rock a cradle)
・{心|こころ}を{揺|ゆ}らす (move someone emotionally, lit. shake the heart)
